 Australian TV reporter rescues man from sinking car
 An Australian television reporter and a bystander rescued a man from a car as it was engulfed by flood waters in Morayfield, Queensland. Will Murray, a journalist with Australia’s public broadcaster ABC, was reporting on flooding when a man became trapped in a four-wheel drive.
